x-sections.title: General
x-sections.description: The width, indentation, and newlines of the file.

x-sections.title: Tables
x-sections.description: The indentation of table headers and their entries.

x-sections.title: Arrays and inline tables
x-sections.description: When arrays and inline tables go on a single line, and their spacing and trailing commas.

x-sections.title: Values and comments
x-sections.description: The quotes of strings and the spacing of key/value pairs and comments.

x-sections.title: Sorting
x-sections.description: The order of the entries of tables and inline tables and the values of arrays.

useTabs.description: Whether to use tabs (true) or spaces (false).

oneOf.description: Uses tabs for indentation.
Uses spaces for indentation.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses carriage return, line feed.
Uses line feed.

quoteStyle.description: Which quote to use for a single-line string. A string is only rewritten when doing so doesn't require adding an escape, since a basic string and a literal string spell a backslash differently. Keys are left as written.

oneOf.description: Keeps the quote the string was written with.
Uses a double quote when doing so doesn't require adding an escape (ex. `'a'` becomes `"a"`).
Uses a single quote when doing so doesn't require adding an escape (ex. `"a"` becomes `'a'`).

indentTables.description: Whether to indent a table header that is a subtable of the header above it.

oneOf.description: Indents a table header that was written indented and leaves the rest at the margin.
Indents every table header by how many of the headers above it name one of its ancestors.
Writes every table header at the margin.

indentEntries.description: Whether to indent the entries of a table a level in from its header. Entries written above the first table header are never indented.

oneOf.description: Indents the entries that were written further in than their table header.
Indents every table's entries.
Writes a table's entries at the same indent as its header.

trailingCommas.description: When to write a trailing comma after the last value of an array or inline table.

oneOf.description: Writes one only when the array or inline table is written over multiple lines.
Never writes one.

spaceSurroundingEquals.description: Whether to write a space on either side of the `=` of a key/value pair.

oneOf.description: ex. `key = 1`
ex. `key=1`

sortKeys.description: Whether to alphabetically sort the entries of each table. Entries separated by a blank line are sorted within their own run, and table headers are never moved. A comment travels with the entry written beneath it, unless a blank line sets it apart -- either above it or between it and the entry -- which marks it as a heading for the run and keeps it at the top.

oneOf.description: Sorts the entries of each table.
Maintains the order of the entries.

sortArrays.description: Whether to alphabetically sort the values of an array. Values separated by a blank line are sorted within their own run, unless the array is written on a single line, which leaves nowhere to keep those dividers. An array holding an array or inline table is left alone. A comment travels with the value written beneath it, unless a blank line sets it apart -- either above it or between it and the value -- which marks it as a heading for the run and keeps it at the top. Note that this changes the meaning of a document whose array order is significant.

oneOf.description: Sorts the values of each array.
Maintains the order of the values.

sortInlineTables.description: Whether to alphabetically sort the entries of an inline table. A comment travels with the entry written beneath it, unless a blank line sets it apart -- either above it or between it and the entry -- which marks it as a heading for the run and keeps it at the top.

oneOf.description: Sorts the entries of each inline table.
Maintains the order of the entries.

preferSingleLine.description: Whether to collapse an array or inline table written over several lines onto a single line when it fits. A comment written within one keeps it expanded.

oneOf.description: Puts arrays and inline tables that span multiple lines on a single line when they fit within the line width.
Maintains arrays and inline tables being on multiple lines.

array.preferSingleLine.description: Whether to collapse an array written over several lines onto a single line when it fits. A comment written within it keeps it expanded. Defaults to whatever `preferSingleLine` is set to.

oneOf.description: Puts an array that spans multiple lines on a single line when it fits within the line width.
Maintains an array being on multiple lines.

inlineTable.preferSingleLine.description: Whether to collapse an inline table written over several lines onto a single line. A comment written anywhere within it keeps it expanded. Defaults to whatever `preferSingleLine` is set to.

oneOf.description: Puts an inline table that spans multiple lines on a single line.
Maintains an inline table being on multiple lines.

array.spaceSurroundingBrackets.description: Whether to write a space inside the brackets of a single-line array.

inlineTable.spaceSurroundingBraces.description: Whether to write a space inside the braces of a single-line inline table.

comment.forceLeadingSpace.description: Whether to force a leading space in a comment.

oneOf.description: Adds a leading space if there is none (ex. `# comment`)
Doesn't force a space to be added and maintains what was done (ex. `#comment`)

cargo.applyConventions.description: Whether to apply sorting to a `Cargo.toml` file.

oneOf.description: Sorts the package section, the dependency sections, and the workspace members in the conventional order.
Maintains the order of the entries.

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the printer will try to stay under. Note that the printer may exceed this width in certain cases.

indentWidth.description: The number of characters for an indent.
